text:
Do not visit unless you want to potentially be locked inside.

1. Tried to use self-serve kiosk but it wasn't working properly.
2. Went to counter to order instead, where 3 employees were chatting. I made eye contact with one and she ignored me, until another worker came by a couple of mins later and pointed out that I was waiting to order.
3. When I tried to order a Big Mac, the lady who'd made eye contact with me previously stared at me as if she wasn't sure why I was talking to her.
4. Here comes the kicker. I wanted to use the washroom after my meal, but I couldn't find one, so I asked. Turns out there's a metal roll-up door at the back, near the counter. It was closed but an employee opened it for me with a button on the wall. It opened up to a whole other area of McDonald's with more seating as well as the washrooms. The toilet cubicle had the biggest gap in the door and anyone would've been able to see everything. Not great, but not the main issue. Main issue was when I came out, that roll-up door was shut. I knocked loudly on the door several times to no avail. There was no button on my side of the door either. I paced around for a while and knocked several more times until I realized no one was coming, so I started pounding on the door. That's when I finally heard voices outside exclaiming that someone was inside, and the door started opening. 3 employees stood outside apologizing.

Use the washrooms at your own risk.
author: Jacquie W

text: Giving one star because zero isn’t an option. I just came wanting my McDouble, I see it on the counter sitting there for a solid 10 minutes, and they don’t give it to me. I point it out to the lady and she looks at me as if I’m from a different planet??? Like bro just give me my McDouble. I was about to go grab it myself. Then I come back to get a McChicken, and they don’t know how to stack a fricking burger! Half the sauce is left in the box and I have to reconstruct the burger myself and get sauce everywhere. On top of this the music is so ass. Shoutout to Jeremiah though, he came over asked if I needed anything then took my trash without me asking, great guy. Everything except Jeremiah was disappointing. Don’t come here unless you like being let down.
author: Bijan Markazi

text: There is quite a lot of houseless people who are drug dependent. The other day I went there and people were smoking drug inside and they were blocking the entrance. I understand that it was very cold out there but it puts people in the restaurant in danger because people could accidentally inhale, what they’re smoking. I told the staff and they didn’t do anything about it. I also understand that there is limited security and there’s not a lot of warm places for them to go, but it just makes me feel really uncomfortable. I hope in the future there can be better system in place for them to smoke their drugs somewhere else.
author: sydney mcdonald

text: It says 24 hours, I understand closing for maintenance but they’re closed for extended periods of time. Sometimes from 12-5 am. Working night shifts I come here expecting it to be open. The staff at night also have an issue of ignoring customers and staying glued to their phones. This lady had my order ready for over 5 minutes and was just texting on her phone before I asked for the bag in front of her? This is a repeated issue. I would call before making the trip at nights but no one picks up the phone either. I’d give 0 stars if I could.
author: Nannu

text:
I went in around 10:50 pm and it wasn’t busy, only about 3 or 4 people other than me in when I was ordering. Got my food decently fast which is nice, but now the issue. The bun is stale, hard, literally a brick of bread..

Is it too much work to check if you food is still good? Too hard to just feel the bread and be like “oh this is stale I shouldn’t use it” like come on man do the job properly 😭💔
author: Nomzzey

text: Terrible experience. I waited for my order for almost 10 minutes, and when it was time to get my pie they just offered me a different flavor. I clearly said I wanted the exact one I ordered, and they told me I would have to wait another 13 minutes. Zero respect for the customer. The service is awful. One of the worst McDonald’s locations I’ve ever seen.
author: Oleksandr Sviridov

text: I placed an order at McDonald’s, order number 2136, on August 9, 2025. The staff member preparing the order wasn’t wearing gloves, which I let slide. The food was cold, but I ignored that too. However, when I opened the wrap, it completely fell apart. Please provide your staff with proper training on how to make a wrap correctly.

text: Ordered a McChicken and they put a junior chicken patty in it… what kind of rip off is this? There is something very sinister going on in this place. I understand it’s another Crackdonald’s but why do the employees have to act like they’re on the funky as well?

text:

I found mold on the fries.
After eating the food, both my mother and I felt very sick (stomach pain, diarrhea, and even vomiting). It was extremely unpleasant and concerning.
